title: Extended Lemoine conjecture
statement: For every odd n≥9 there are odd primes p,q,r,s and natural numbers a,b such that p+2q=n, 2+pq=2^a+r, and 2p+q=2^b+s.

counterexample.description: An odd integer n≥9 for which exhaustive bounded prime and power-of-two enumeration finds no six witnesses satisfying all three equations.
